title: Each type during load-shedding
caption:
Lights out. Sixteen types, sixteen survival strategies.

One charged everything at 5 and is completely unbothered. One is writing verses by candlelight. One rewired the UPS without telling anyone. One started antakshari and refuses to stop now that the power is back.

Tag the person you want next to you during the next outage.

Which one are you when the lights go?

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
